about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Mark Pocan

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR THE CONDEMNATION AND DENOUNCEMENT OF SOCIALISM IN ALL ITS FORMS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR THE CONDEMNATION AND DENOUNCEMENT OF SOCIALISM IN ALL ITS FORMS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
sentences: This is just stupid, and it is insulting to Americans trying to get by while this Congress lets tariffs increase the cost of groceries and other goods, lets an illegal war in Iran raise gas prices, and the big, beautiful bill raise the cost of healthcare and utilities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
statements.title: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
sentences: As a Member of Congress, I don't own any individual stocks because, as a byproduct of my job, I get inside information on many publicly traded companies.
However, this bill before us puts Members of Congress above the law.
It is not a real congressional stock trading ban like other bipartisan measures.
It still allows Members to buy stocks with dividends.
It still allows family members to buy stocks for others for any reason.
It is basically the opposite of a real stock trading ban for Members of Congress, a wolf in sheep's clothing.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CUBAN BLOCKADE IS INHUMANE
statements.title: CUBAN BLOCKADE IS INHUMANE
sentences: Our punishing of the people of Cuba has not brought the regime change that some politicians want, but we are pushing our boot harder onto the necks of the people.
When the power goes out, which it does quite often due to our oil ban, surgeons finish surgeries with the light from their cell phones because of our blockade.
The people of America are tired of war and regime change.
Yet, starting another conflict while in a quagmire in Iran is the last thing we need.
We forced the world into an involuntary global blockade, as well, as we will punish anyone who does business with these sanctions.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECT AMERICA'S WORKFORCE ACT
statements.title: PROTECT AMERICA'S WORKFORCE ACT
sentences: Earlier this year, Donald Trump did an illegal executive order, stripping a million Federal workers from their collective bargaining rights, rights they have had since 1962.
In 2011, Governor Scott Walker launched one of the most aggressive attacks on workers' rights, stripping collective bargaining rights.
This bill will restore longstanding collective bargaining protections and ensure that any future administration cannot demolish these rights again.
We value them, and we are fighting with them.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 5371, CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 5371, CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: We won't protect the 22 million people paying more for the ACA or the 15 million people losing their healthcare outright due to Republican actions in the big, ugly law, nor will we stop the healthcare rate increases for everyone in this country.
Nor will we be able today to roll back the tax cuts for billionaires and Republicans' GOP donors that they funded by gutting those healthcare and food programs.

We won't be restoring food assistance today for the millions of Americans who benefit from SNAP because House Republicans voted to cut the number one program that keeps kids and seniors out of poverty by over $180 billion.
We are going to be on Republicans day after day until we get it done.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONDEMNING BENJAMIN NETANYAHU
statements.title: CONDEMNING BENJAMIN NETANYAHU
sentences: Nor am I ignoring the decades of isolation that Gaza has endured by the Israeli Government, essentially turning the small but densely populated region into an open-air prison from which few could easily come and go as they pleased.
The killing of people in hospitals and those trying to get food aid, normally considered off-limits even in war, occurs regularly, with an official shrug when the Israeli Government is called out.

The definition of genocide by the New Oxford American Dictionary is ``the deliberate killing of a large number of people from a particular nation or ethnic group with the aim of destroying that nation or group.'' That is exactly what we are seeing in Gaza right now by the Israeli Government under Benjamin Netanyahu, an accused war criminal by the International Criminal Court.
Israeli groups like B'Tselem and Physicians for Human Rights-Israel have recently called what is happening genocide.
International human rights groups like Human Rights Watch and Amnesty International have as well.

The United Nations' special committee said last November that Israel's war conduct in Gaza is ``consistent with the characteristics of genocide,'' including mass civilian casualties and using starvation as a weapon.
No weapons should be sent from the United States to Israel that could be used against the people of Gaza.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LISTENING TO OUR CONSTITUENTS
statements.title: LISTENING TO OUR CONSTITUENTS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise to discuss the special election that we had in Wisconsin last Tuesday for the Wisconsin Supreme Court.

It was an overwhelming rebuke of the Trump-Musk agenda of cutting Medicaid, healthcare, long-term care, education funding, and food assistance to pay for a transfer of wealth of $4.5 trillion from the middle class and those aspiring to the wealthiest in this country.
Trump's tariffs are taxes on working people.
They don't want people who work for veteran hospitals or Social Security to have their jobs cut just to pay for Elon Musk and Donald Trump's tax cuts.

They are rightfully afraid that the Republicans are going after their Social Security, after Musk called it a Ponzi scheme, after Trump lied about the program over and over in the state of the Union, and after the Secretary of Commerce said people could go a month without their Social Security check unless they were fraudsters.
When we go home for this coming Easter break, I will do more townhalls, both in my district and in Republican districts, to make sure that people are being heard.

statements.title: PARSLEY
sentences: We are going to encourage, and where we can, participate in lawsuits, and we are going to expose those who sit quietly by and allow a want- to-be authoritarian and his billionaire benefactor to attempt to destroy our democracy.
USAID doesn't offer much profit for Musk, so he wants it dismantled, but NASA does, and his contract likely won't get touched.

It is unconscionable that Elon can collect $20 billion from American taxpayers with one hand while slashing funds for childcare and healthcare, nutrition assistance, and public education with the other.
He tried to steal money that Congress appropriated for the American people so that he could provide a tax break to Elon Musk and other billionaires and multimillionaires across the country.
His main focus has been to raise the $4 trillion that he needs to fund his tax break for the wealthiest for the next 10 years.

That theft will ultimately take away funds from education and housing, healthcare, veterans benefits, and funds for working people so that we can give billionaires an extra home in the Cayman Islands or membership to Mar-a-Lago.
Social Security and Medicare should beware.
Programs like Medicaid, healthcare and long-term care for people with disabilities and those in need, for sure beware.
We may not be in the majority but we are going to call out every illegal action and improper use of power that the executive branch is taking that is hurting our country.
We will fight Republicans' enabling agenda in Congress.
We won't be washed off the plate.
I am introducing legislation to ensure that special government employees like Musk cannot profit off of government contracts.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING FEDERAL WORKERS
statements.title: SUPPORTING FEDERAL WORKERS
sentences: As a co-chair of the Congressional Labor Caucus, I am proud to stand with our essential workers who keep the government running every day.

Unelected billionaire Elon Musk has been bulldozing through the Federal workforce, demanding the firing of hundreds of thousands of employees whose only fireable offense is trying to serve the American people.
They process Social Security checks for seniors.
Elon Musk and Trump will continue to put lives at risk as they seek to cut $4 trillion over the next 10 years to pay for tax cuts for Elon Musk, Donald Trump, and the wealthiest.
We are fighting in Congress to oppose Donald Trump and Elon Musk's baseless attacks on you and your important work.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Does this mean hiring potential predators to peek at the private parts of kids in locker rooms?
Mr. Speaker, I urge a ``no'' vote.
